# The core pack (generated by `cargo xtask format-docs`; do not edit)

Files: `core.ron` ([CoreFile](#corefile)), `gfx/<sprite>.png`, `sounds/<file>`.

The core pack's authoring format: `core.ron`, `gfx/<id>.png` (RGBA with alpha), `sounds/<file>` and OLX's colours. Compiled to the runtime `CoreDef` and sprites, and lifted from them (docs/porting/olx-notes/asset-formats.md §5). Not named `core`: a crate-root module of that name would shadow the `core` crate.

<a id="corefile"></a>

## CoreFile (`core.ron`)

`core.ron`: OLX's shared game assets (`CORE_LAYOUT` lists OLX's sprites).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |
| `sprites` | map of name → [SpriteEntry](#spriteentry) | `{}` | Each sprite `gfx/<id>.png` by id, such as `crosshair`, at most `MAX_SPRITES` (256). |
| `sounds` | list of string | `[]` | The sound files `sounds/<file>`, such as `throw.ogg`, at most `MAX_SOUNDS` (1024). |
| `colours` | map of name → [colour](#colour) | `{}` | OLX's `colours.cfg` values by its key, such as `RopeColour1`, at most `MAX_COLOURS` (1024). |

<a id="spriteentry"></a>

## SpriteEntry

One sprite's frame grid.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frames` | (integer, integer) | required | Columns and rows of frames; they must divide the image. |
| `art_scale` | integer | required | Art pixels per world pixel, 1 to `MAX_ART_SCALE` (8). |

<a id="colour"></a>

## colour

A colour in an authoring file: `"#rrggbb"` (opaque) or `"#rrggbbaa"` (alpha 00 transparent to ff opaque), hex digits read in any case. Written lowercase, without the alpha when opaque.
